purpose: Collect six-DRL per-instance quality and timing for the main comparison
timing_entrypoint: Each method's eval.py in a separate process for each complete run
timing_device: CUDA GPU, without competing GPU jobs
timing_aggregation: median of five complete 100-instance run means; no duration-based trimming
rpd_denominator_policy: Determine per-instance BKS only after merging DRL, Gurobi, and all metaheuristic feasible objectives
